name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_relapsing_remitting_multiple_sclerosis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_illness_value_recorded_now_withunit_years
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration of the patient's illness in years at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of the patient's illness in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.
when_value: Set to the number of years since the onset of the patient's illness, as recorded at the current time.

name: patient_has_finding_of_recurrent_disease_inthepast3months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had recurrent disease (relapses) in the past three months.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had any episodes of recurrent disease (relapses) in the past three months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had any episodes of recurrent disease (relapses) in the past three months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had recurrent disease (relapses) in the past three months.

name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kg_per_m2
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's body mass index (BMI) in kg/m^2 as recorded now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no BMI measurement recorded now is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured BMI value in kg/m^2 if a BMI measurement recorded now is available.
